meta.name: ponytail-coding
meta.description: Forces the laziest solution that actually works, simplest, shortest, most minimal. Channels a senior dev who has seen everything: question whether the task needs to exist at all (YAGNI), reach for the standard library before custom code, native platform features before dependencies, one line before fifty. Supports intensity levels: lite, full (default), ultra. Use whenever the user says "ponytail", "be lazy", "lazy mode", "simplest solution", "minimal solution", "yagni", "do less", or "shortest path", and whenever they complain about over-engineering, bloat, boilerplate, or unnecessary dependencies.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 强制用最懒但能用的最短方案写代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果总想写最少代码、拒绝过度工程化。
copy.tagline_en: Force the laziest working solution in code.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you always want the shortest code and hate over-engineering.

howto.what: Claude 会优先给出最懒但能用的代码：先质疑任务是否必要，再用标准库和平台原生功能，最后才写自定义代码。输出代码后最多附三行说明跳过了什么、何时补充。
howto.when: 当你说出“ponytail”、“be lazy”、“lazy mode”、“simplest solution”等关键词，或抱怨过度工程、臃肿、样板代码、不必要的依赖时触发。

say.text: 用 ponytail 模式帮我写一个缓存函数。
这个 API 调用太复杂了，帮我简化。
say.note: Claude 会删除不必要的抽象，只保留最简实现。

say.text: 切换到 ultra 级别，我要最极简的方案。
say.note: Claude 会极端遵循 YAGNI，甚至挑战需求本身。

howto.what_en: Claude will prioritize the laziest working code: first question if the task is needed, then use stdlib and native platform features, and only write custom code as last resort. After code, at most three lines explaining what was skipped and when to add it.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "ponytail", "be lazy", "lazy mode", "simplest solution", etc., or complain about over-engineering, bloat, boilerplate, or unnecessary dependencies.

say_en.text: Use ponytail mode to write a cache function for me.
say_en.note: Claude will use stdlib lru_cache instead of a custom cache class.

say_en.text: This API call is too complex, simplify it.
Switch to ultra level, I want the most minimal solution.
say_en.note: Claude will follow YAGNI extremely, even challenging the requirement itself.
